result.instructions: Tools for Plaky, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items on our product roadmap board are still in To do?"; "Create a new task called 'Fix checkout timeout' in the Engineering space, in the Backlog group."; "Add a comment to item 42 saying the fix is in review.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Plaky data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run plaky_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run plaky_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run plaky_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. plaky_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: plaky_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Return the owner of the API key: id, name, email, role (OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER/VIEWER) and status. Good first call to verify the key works. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/users/me.

tools.name: plaky_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List workspace users, optionally filtered by email, status (ACTIVE/PENDING/INACTIVE) or role (OWNER/ADMIN/MEMBER/VIEWER). Plaky API: GET /v1/public/users.

emails.description: Only users with these email addresses.

tools.name: plaky_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List workspace teams. Use the team ids when you subscribe teams to items. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/teams.

tools.name: plaky_get_team
tools.title: Get a team
tools.description: Get one team by id, with its members. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/teams/{teamId}.

tools.name: plaky_list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List spaces in the workspace. Pass expand=['board'] to include each space's boards. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces.

expand.description: Use 'board' to include boards inside each space.

tools.name: plaky_get_space
tools.title: Get a space
tools.description: Get one space by id. Pass expand=['board'] to include its boards. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}.

tools.name: plaky_list_boards
tools.title: List boards in a space
tools.description: List the boards in one space. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards.

tools.name: plaky_get_board
tools.title: Get a board
tools.description: Get one board: its fields (keys, titles, types, allowed values) and groups. Call it first to learn the field keys before you set values. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}.

tools.name: plaky_list_item_groups
tools.title: List item groups
tools.description: List the item groups (sections) of a board. Use their ids for plaky_create_item and plaky_move_item_to_group. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/item-groups.

tools.name: plaky_list_items
tools.title: List items on a board
tools.description: List items on a board, optionally in one board view or under one parent item. subitems_behaviour: INCLUDE (default), EXCLUDE or EMBED. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items.

board_view_id.description: Only items shown in this board view.

parent_id.description: Only subitems of this parent item.

expand.description: Relationships to return as full objects instead of ids.

tools.name: plaky_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one item with its field values, group and subitem count. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items/{itemId}.

expand.description: Relationships to return as full objects instead of ids.

tools.name: plaky_list_subitems
tools.title: List subitems
tools.description: List the subitems of one item. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items/{itemId}/sub-items.

expand.description: Relationships to return as full objects instead of ids.

tools.name: plaky_list_item_comments
tools.title: List item comments
tools.description: List the comments on one item, with replies and reactions. Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items/{itemId}/comments.

tools.name: plaky_list_item_files
tools.title: List item files
tools.description: List the files attached to one item (name, size, type, uploader). Plaky API: GET /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items/{itemId}/files.

tools.name: plaky_get_item_file_download_url
tools.title: Get a file download link
tools.description: Return a short-lived presigned download URL for one item file (see expiresInSeconds). The file bytes are not returned. Plaky API: GET .../files/{itemFileId}/download.

tools.name: plaky_create_item
tools.title: Create an item or subitem
tools.description: Create an item on a board, or a subitem when parent_id is set. Fields map a field key or title to a value. Writes data: creates a new item on each call. Plaky API: POST /v1/public/spaces/{spaceId}/boards/{boardId}/items.

parent_id.description: Parent item id: creates a subitem under it.

group_id.description: Item group id to place the item in (from plaky_list_item_groups).

fields.description: Field values keyed by field key or title.

additionalProperties.description: Field value by type: text or number as-is; status as label or id; tag as array of labels or ids; date as ISO-8601 string; timeline as {start,end}; person as {users:[{id|email}],teams:[{id|title}]}; link as URL or {url,displayText}.

tools.name: plaky_update_item_field
tools.title: Set one field value
tools.description: Set the value of one field on an item. The field is a key ('status-1') or a title ('Status'). Setting the same value again changes nothing. Plaky API: PATCH .../items/{itemId}/fields/{itemFieldKey}.

field_key.description: Field key or field title, from plaky_get_board.

value.description: Field value by type: text or number as-is; status as label or id; tag as array of labels or ids; date as ISO-8601 string; timeline as {start,end}; person as {users:[{id|email}],teams:[{id|title}]}; link as URL or {url,displayText}.

tools.name: plaky_move_item_to_group
tools.title: Move an item to a group
tools.description: Move an item to another item group on the same board. The item is added to the end of the target group. Plaky API: PATCH .../items/{itemId}/group.

annotations.title: Move an item to a group

tools.name: plaky_add_item_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an item, or a reply when reply_to_comment_id is set. Writes data: each call posts a new comment. Plaky API: POST .../items/{itemId}/comments.

reply_to_comment_id.description: Comment id to reply to (from plaky_list_item_comments).

tools.name: plaky_set_comment_reactions
tools.title: Set your reactions on a comment
tools.description: Set the emoji reactions the API key's user leaves on one comment. Replaces the current reactions; an empty list removes them. Emoji codes are hex, e.g. '1f44d' (thumbs up). Plaky API: PUT .../comments/{itemCommentId}/reactions.

reaction_codes.description: Emoji hex codes, e.g. ['1f44d']. Empty list removes all.

annotations.title: Set your reactions on a comment

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Plaky
prompts.description: What you can do with Plaky here, with example requests to try.
